name: Barrow crypt entrance
description: A grassy hillside barrow mouth about 3 × 3 m and 2.5 m high: a turf mound with a passage cut into its front, lined with dry-stone walls, framed by two weathered standing stones under a heavy lintel, with worn stone steps that thin and darken as they go down into the black mouth. Two more old standing stones lean at the foot of the mound.

provenance.prompt: A grassy hillside barrow mouth framed by old standing stones and a lintel, worn stone steps going down into it, about 3 × 3 × 2.5 m, front on -y.
